title: Add privacy-conscious analytics + CV download tracking

questions.prompt: Which analytics provider should we use?
questions.description: The site is a static Astro build on GitHub Pages. All options below support seeing visits; the recommended ones are cookieless (no consent banner needed) and support custom events for CV-download tracking. Cost and setup effort differ.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Umami Cloud — free tier, cookieless/GDPR-friendly, first-class custom events for CV downloads, one <script> tag. Good balance of free + capable.

options.label: Umami Cloud (free tier, cookieless, custom events)
Cloudflare Web Analytics (free, cookieless, limited custom events)
Google Analytics 4 (free, powerful, but heavier + needs a consent banner)

questions.prompt: Beyond page views/visitors, which interactions should we track as events?
questions.description: Page views and visitor counts come by default. These are the extra click events worth capturing to answer 'are recruiters engaging?'
questions.recommendedAnswer: Track CV downloads (distinguishing EN vs SLO) and outbound clicks to LinkedIn / GitHub / email.

options.label: CV downloads (distinguish EN vs SLO PDF)

questions.description: Cookieless providers generally don't require a cookie consent banner under GDPR, though a short privacy note is good practice. The site currently has no footer.
questions.recommendedAnswer: No cookie banner (cookieless provider), plus a short one-line privacy note. I'd add a minimal footer to hold it since there isn't one today.

options.label: No banner + short privacy note (add minimal footer)

questions.prompt: How should we handle the analytics account / tracking ID?
questions.description: Most providers give you a website ID + script src after you create an account. I can't create the account for you.
questions.recommendedAnswer: I scaffold the integration reading the ID from a build-time env var (e.g. PUBLIC_UMAMI_WEBSITE_ID) with a placeholder; you create the account and drop in the real ID (also add it to the GitHub Actions deploy workflow).

options.label: Scaffold with env var + placeholder; I fill in the real ID later
I'll create the account now and paste the ID/snippet into chat
Hardcode the ID directly in the layout once I have it

questions.prompt: Any loading constraints for the analytics script?
questions.description: Sensible defaults to avoid skewing your own numbers and to respect privacy signals.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Load only on the production site (skip local dev), and don't count visits from your own machine if the provider supports it.

options.label: Only load on production (not local dev)
Exclude my own visits where possible
Respect Do Not Track browser setting
